file_metadata_annotation.rule: The anchors file's metadata object carries a spec029_phase_h_annotation block recording this annotation's date, the schema path, the validation_status vocabulary, and the strict-set rule's identifier, version, source, and register (H2: the rule's identifier and version are recorded in the file metadata). The block is additive metadata only; removing it (with the per-record Phase H fields) reproduces the Phase-D-stamped file byte-identically.

record_shape.governing_rule: A record's shape is DECLARED iff (a) it carries every required core field, every Phase D additive field, and every Phase H additive field, (b) it carries no field outside the union of those sets and the optional fields below, and (c) every governed field satisfies its declared type / vocabulary. The CI validator (H4) fails on any record whose shape is undeclared under this schema.
record_shape.observed_shapes_note: Before this schema the file had accreted 56 distinct record field shapes (Spec 029 audit §5-P2). Every observed field is declared above: the 56 shapes are exactly the combinations of the required/additive fields with subsets of the optional fields. The annotation pass normalised the shapes additively only in the H1/H2 sense — every record gained the total Phase H fields; no record gained or lost any other field.

serialization.note: The file's canonical serialization, round-trip byte-identical since before Spec 029 Phase D. Every canonical comparison in the test suite relies on it.

strict_set_rule.definition: An anchor is in the strict set iff its confidence is HIGH or MEDIUM, its Phase-108 register category is not SA_DERIVED / SA_CONFIRMED_ONLY, and its register record has sa_in_chain false. The stored strict_set flag on each record is a cache of this join; the CI validator recomputes it from the register + rule and fails on any disagreement.
strict_set_rule.rule_version: Phase-109 follow-through (spec 007, 2026-10-06) applying the Phase-108 strict definition

validation_status_derivation.rule: derive_validation_status(record, register_record, in_strict_set): (1) a validation_status already present on the record is preserved verbatim (H1); (2) else, if the record is in the computed strict set, strict_sa_independent; (3) else, if the register record carries sa_in_chain true, sa_in_provenance_chain; (4) else no_validation_record. The stored value is a cache of this derivation; the CI validator recomputes it for every record and fails on disagreement.

no_validation_record.assigned_by: Spec 029 Phase H annotation (the Spec 029 audit ledger's own flag for these records)
no_validation_record.definition: LOW anchor carrying no validation outcome recorded under any live method: a distributional / research-loop proposal only (Phase-109 Step 1(c) demoted it one tier as staging-heuristic origin, unvalidated). The audit ledger flags these records no_validation_record; the value makes that state explicit in the file.

pending_non_sa_validation.assigned_by: Phase-109 Step 2 (spec 007), pre-existing — preserved verbatim by Phase H
pending_non_sa_validation.definition: SA-lineage anchor (Phase-108 register category SA_DERIVED or SA_CONFIRMED_ONLY; the anchor also carries provenance_class naming the category) flagged as presented pending non-SA validation after Phase-107 falsified SA as evidence for sign values.

premise_superseded.assigned_by: Phase-110/111 (spec 008), pre-existing — preserved verbatim by Phase H
premise_superseded.definition: CANDIDATE anchor of the 'kur' cohort whose proposing premise was superseded (M222 adjudication, spec 008). All 113 records read 'kur'.

sa_in_provenance_chain.assigned_by: Spec 029 Phase H annotation (derived from the Phase-108 register's sa_in_chain field)
sa_in_provenance_chain.definition: HIGH anchor whose Phase-108 register record carries sa_in_chain true but whose register category is not an SA-lineage category (DEDR / LITERATURE / MIXED), so Phase-109 Step 2 did not flag it pending_non_sa_validation. It fails the strict SA-independence rule and carries no SA-free validation outcome — the Spec 029 audit's 33 chained HIGH anchors (§4 item 2, §5-P1), now distinguishable in the file itself.

strict_sa_independent.assigned_by: Spec 029 Phase H annotation (derived; the value is a cache recomputable from the record's register evidence)
strict_sa_independent.definition: HIGH or MEDIUM anchor passing the Phase-108/109 strict SA-independence rule: its Phase-108 register category is not an SA-lineage category (SA_DERIVED / SA_CONFIRMED_ONLY) and the register records no SA in its provenance chain (sa_in_chain false). This is a lane-1 provenance check with a recorded outcome (the audit's checked staging rule for anchors); it is not an outcome of the Phase-113/115 non-SA batteries, which used this set as their calibration core and applied their outcomes only to the pending set.
strict_sa_independent.strict_set_correspondence: Exactly the records carrying strict_set true.
